rows.case: N29 drag down from half CLOSES the sheet

rows.behaviour: Closing the note editor returns the sheet to the half stop

rounds.surface: create-route currency guards: grid, fallback prep, city search, type-ahead arm
rounds.cut: the guards' hand-written capture/threading: (gen, session) args through the prep watchdog + ticker, the inline landing check, the armSeq local, repeated guard calls at landing seats

rows.behaviour: A stale grid landing lands nowhere (CG-PF-05): the pack resolve landing after the watchdog orphaned the grid changes nothing - now judged by the grid record's captured lander instead of crGridCurrent(g) at the seat
rows.case: F1 ORPHANED INIT LANDING (bd0e7df)
rows.observes: the pack resolve's late landing against the stalled grid: no pack identity, dataset or cells adopted, the FAILED settle stands

rows.behaviour: A healthy city pick readies through the grid's landings (pack resolve, saved-grid read, cell landings), judged by the captured lander; a resume re-adopts the same record under a new generation and judges current again
rows.case: S1 (healthy city pick)
rows.observes: the none->preparing->ready edges with every cell done and no setter refusal recorded

rows.behaviour: The currency predicates keep their true input shapes (street search sequence only, city search sequence + session, city catch sequence only) - they survive as the combinators' engines, not as landing-seat evaluations
rows.case: A0 (the record + G3 predicates)
rows.observes: the predicates' live answers in the page: current true, stale and wrong-session false

rows.behaviour: A held city search is current before the close owner acts and stale after it on both currency checks; a search issued after the close is current at the new sequence
rows.case: 5: the held search was current before the close and is stale after it, on both currency checks
rows.observes: the predicates' answers run against crResetCitySearch's sequence bump, abort and debounce clear

rows.behaviour: The fallback prep's mirror watchdog still forces the failed landing past the stall bound, orphaning the wedged landing by generation - now handed the captured preparing lander instead of (gen, session) arguments
rows.case: 4e: the fallback box prep carries the mirror watchdog, orphaning its wedged landing by generation
rows.observes: the watchdog's definition and its ticker call in parts/create-citydata.js

rows.behaviour: A failed city search still clears the results box under the sequence-only check, no local fallback standing on a failure - now judged by the captured landError lander
rows.case: B11: a failed fetch still clears the box - no local fallback stands on a failure
rows.observes: the catch's guard text inside crRunCitySearch in parts/create-pick.js

rows.behaviour: A failed search request shows nothing false and does not wedge the pane - the catch landing through the captured landError lander
rows.case: D5 HONEST FAILURE
rows.observes: the results box after a failed request: no rows and no false empty line, and the next search answering normally
